# Third-party files in this folder

These are unmodified copies, served from this site so that visitors' browsers never contact a third-party CDN.

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| web-llm.js | [@mlc-ai/web-llm](https://github.com/mlc-ai/web-llm) | 0.2.85 | Apache-2.0 |
| pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs | [pdf.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) (pdfjs-dist, legacy build for older browsers) | 6.3.289 | Apache-2.0 |
| mammoth.browser.min.js | [mammoth.js](https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js) | 1.13.0 | BSD-2-Clause |
| jspdf.umd.min.js | [jsPDF](https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF) | 4.2.1 | MIT |
| docx.iife.js | [docx](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx) | 9.8.1 | MIT |
| DejaVuSans.ttf | [DejaVu Fonts](https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/) | 2.37 | Bitstream Vera / public domain (free licence) |

The AI models themselves are downloaded by the visitor's browser from Hugging Face ([mlc-ai](https://huggingface.co/mlc-ai)) and carry their own licences: Qwen2.5 1.5B and 7B under Apache-2.0, Llama 3.2 3B under the Llama 3.2 Community License (Built with Llama).
